	pair_id INTEGER NOT NULL,

	open_price NUMERIC(24, 8) NOT NULL, 
	high_price NUMERIC(24, 8) NOT NULL, 
	low_price NUMERIC(24, 8) NOT NULL, 
	close_price NUMERIC(24, 8) NOT NULL, 
	gold_volume NUMERIC(30, 6) NOT NULL, 
	n_trades INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	first_event_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	first_event_id BIGINT, 
	last_event_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	last_event_id BIGINT, 
	n_events INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,

	CONSTRAINT ck_fx_candle_h_ge_l CHECK (high_price >= low_price), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_fx_candle_events_non_negative CHECK (n_events >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_fx_candle_n_non_negative CHECK (n_trades >= 0),

)

CREATE TABLE fx_short_position (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	pair_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	principal_foreign NUMERIC(24, 6) NOT NULL,

	CONSTRAINT ck_fx_short_position_state CHECK ((principal_foreign + interest_foreign > 0 AND interest_last_accrued_at IS NOT NULL) OR (principal_foreign = 0 AND interest_foreign = 0 AND restricted_gold = 0 AND proceeds_basis_gold = 0 AND interest_last_accrued_at IS NULL)),

CREATE TABLE fx_trigger_order (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	pair_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	comparison VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL, 
	trigger_price NUMERIC(16, 6) NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	amount NUMERIC(16, 6), 
	close_percent NUMERIC(9, 6), 
	auto_borrow BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	borrow_limit NUMERIC(16, 6) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	finished_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	observed_trigger_price NUMERIC(24, 8), 
	failure_reason VARCHAR(512), 
	execution_id INTEGER, 
	trade_id INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_fx_order_instruction CHECK ((action IN ('buy','sell') AND amount IS NOT NULL AND amount > 0 AND close_percent IS NULL) OR (action IN ('close_long','close_short') AND amount IS NULL AND close_percent IS NOT NULL AND close_percent > 0 AND close_percent <= 100)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_fx_order_funding CHECK ((auto_borrow OR borrow_limit = 0) AND (action = 'buy' OR (NOT auto_borrow AND borrow_limit = 0))), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_fx_order_comparison CHECK (comparison IN ('lte','gte')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_fx_order_status CHECK (status IN ('waiting','succeeded','failed','cancelled')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_fx_order_result CHECK (execution_id IS NULL OR trade_id IS NULL), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_fx_order_numbers CHECK (trigger_price > 0 AND borrow_limit >= 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(execution_id) REFERENCES fx_execution (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(pair_id) REFERENCES fx_pair (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(trade_id) REFERENCES fx_trade (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES "user" (id)
)

CREATE TABLE fx_pool_event (
	id BIGSERIAL NOT NULL, 
	pair_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	pre_gold_reserve NUMERIC(16, 6), 
	pre_foreign_reserve NUMERIC(16, 6), 
	post_gold_reserve NUMERIC(16, 6) NOT NULL, 
	post_foreign_reserve NUMERIC(16, 6) NOT NULL, 
	gold_volume NUMERIC(16, 6) NOT NULL, 
	trade_id INTEGER, 
	audit_id BIGINT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_fx_pool_event_pre_positive CHECK ((kind = 'initialize' AND pre_gold_reserve IS NULL AND pre_foreign_reserve IS NULL) OR (kind <> 'initialize' AND pre_gold_reserve IS NOT NULL AND pre_foreign_reserve IS NOT NULL AND pre_gold_reserve > 0 AND pre_foreign_reserve > 0)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_fx_pool_event_source CHECK ((kind = 'trade' AND trade_id IS NOT NULL AND audit_id IS NULL) OR (kind <> 'trade' AND trade_id IS NULL AND audit_id IS NOT NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_fx_pool_event_volume CHECK (gold_volume >= 0 AND (kind = 'trade' OR gold_volume = 0)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_fx_pool_event_kind CHECK (kind IN ('initialize','trade','fund','withdraw')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_fx_pool_event_post_positive CHECK (post_gold_reserve > 0 AND post_foreign_reserve > 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(audit_id) REFERENCES audit_event (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(pair_id) REFERENCES fx_pair (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(trade_id) REFERENCES fx_trade (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_fx_pool_event_audit UNIQUE (audit_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_fx_pool_event_trade UNIQUE (trade_id)
)

CREATE TABLE fx_trade (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	execution_id INTEGER, 
	execution_leg INTEGER, 
	pair_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER, 
	purpose VARCHAR(16) DEFAULT 'spot' NOT NULL, 
	requested_foreign_amount NUMERIC(24, 6), 
	borrow_amount NUMERIC(16, 6), 
	max_gold_in NUMERIC(16, 6), 
	cover_all BOOLEAN, 
	side VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	input_amount NUMERIC(16, 6) NOT NULL, 
	output_amount NUMERIC(16, 6) NOT NULL, 
	min_out NUMERIC(16, 6) NOT NULL, 
	fee_amount NUMERIC(16, 6) NOT NULL, 
	pre_gold_reserve NUMERIC(16, 6) NOT NULL, 
	pre_foreign_reserve NUMERIC(16, 6) NOT NULL, 
	post_gold_reserve NUMERIC(16, 6) NOT NULL, 
	post_foreign_reserve NUMERIC(16, 6) NOT NULL, 
	post_price NUMERIC(16, 6) NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(128), 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_fx_trade_borrow_amount CHECK ((purpose = 'borrow_buy' AND side = 'buy' AND borrow_amount IS NOT NULL AND borrow_amount > 0 AND borrow_amount <= input_amount) OR (purpose <> 'borrow_buy' AND borrow_amount IS NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_fx_trade_purpose CHECK (purpose IN ('spot','short_open','short_cover','borrow_buy')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_fx_trade_side CHECK (side IN ('buy','sell')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_fx_trade_execution_link CHECK ((execution_id IS NULL AND execution_leg IS NULL) OR (execution_id IS NOT NULL AND execution_leg IS NOT NULL AND execution_leg IN (1,2) AND idempotency_key IS NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_fx_trade_amounts_positive CHECK (input_amount > 0 AND output_amount > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_fx_trade_reserves_positive CHECK (pre_gold_reserve > 0 AND pre_foreign_reserve > 0 AND post_gold_reserve > 0 AND post_foreign_reserve > 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(execution_id) REFERENCES fx_execution (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(pair_id) REFERENCES fx_pair (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES "user" (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_fx_trade_execution_leg UNIQUE (execution_id, execution_leg), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_fx_trade_user_idempotency UNIQUE (user_id, idempotency_key)
)

)

CREATE TABLE fx_pair (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	currency_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	currency_name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	archived BOOLEAN DEFAULT false NOT NULL, 
	gold_reserve NUMERIC(16, 6) NOT NULL, 
	foreign_reserve NUMERIC(16, 6) NOT NULL, 
	initial_price NUMERIC(16, 6) NOT NULL, 
	buy_fee_rate NUMERIC(10, 8) NOT NULL, 
	sell_fee_rate NUMERIC(10, 8) NOT NULL, 
	short_lending_limit_foreign NUMERIC(24, 6) DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	pool_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reduce_only BOOLEAN DEFAULT false NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_fx_pair_status CHECK (status IN ('draft','trading','paused','closed')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_fx_pair_fee_rate CHECK (buy_fee_rate >= 0 AND buy_fee_rate <= 1 AND sell_fee_rate >= 0 AND sell_fee_rate <= 1), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_fx_pair_reserves_positive CHECK (gold_reserve > 0 AND foreign_reserve > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_fx_pair_short_limit_non_negative CHECK (short_lending_limit_foreign >= 0), 
	UNIQUE (currency_code)
)
